Reviewed gfx950 compute_mode<int,1024> with native 512-thread block (eight wave64 waves) for 256 input values. At .text+0x25520/0x25528, producer index is 2*t-(t&127); v21 is its byte address plus 4. Conditional key swaps at0x255bc write that index and index+128; byte flags at0x255c4/0x255cc follow. EXEC reconverges0x255d4 and LDS wait0x255d8 precedes unconditional barrier0x255dc. Consumer0x255e0 uses v19 built at0x25144..0x2514c from 2*t-(t&63), reading that index and index+64. Thus producer thread0 (wave0) can write key128 read by consumer thread64 (wave1); both are within the 256 valid inputs. No other barrier intervenes. Fresh rocprofv3 trace, exact-name allowlist, static inventory, pristine ISA and numerical baseline are retained under mode-v2 artifacts. Old 128-input single-wave trials are excluded. Select this site before mode-v2 trials and retain across all presets/delays; require exact-one installation, bounded completion and healthy probes.
